description: This PHP source file defines the FormattedNumber class, which provides static methods to detect and convert various formatted numeric strings (such as fractions, percentages, currencies) into numeric values within the PhpSpreadsheet calculation engine. It includes regex patterns for parsing formatted strings and methods for converting different formats based on those patterns.

classes.name: FormattedNumber
classes.description: A utility class that provides static methods to parse and convert formatted string representations of numbers (including fractions, percentages, currencies) into actual numeric types for calculations.

methods.name: convertToNumberIfFormatted
methods.description: Attempts to recognize and convert a formatted number string to a numeric value by applying a sequence of conversion methods.

methods.name: convertToNumberIfNumeric
methods.description: Checks if a string is a numeric value, considering locale-specific thousand and decimal separators, and converts it to a float if applicable.

methods.name: convertToNumberIfFraction
methods.description: Detects fraction strings and converts them into a numeric value using formula calculation.

methods.name: convertToNumberIfPercent
methods.description: Detects percentage strings, parses the value, and converts it to a decimal number representing the percentage.

methods.name: convertToNumberIfCurrency
methods.description: Detects currency-formatted strings, parses the currency value with locale-specific decimal separator, and converts it to a float.

methods.name: currencyMatcherRegexp
methods.description: Generates a regex pattern for matching currency formatted strings, including locale-specific currency symbols and formats.
